consensus_summary: Fans are divided on the performance quality of the 1974-09-14 show at Olympia Halle, with some praising standout moments while others criticize the overall execution. The sound quality, particularly due to the audience patch, has also drawn mixed reactions, but many agree that certain songs shine despite the challenges.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 30 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While there are high points in the performance, several reviewers noted significant flaws, leading to a mixed overall impression.
